interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility, particularly to mitigate the impact of large parked vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or speed cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street environment.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at the nearest intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and traffic while also calming vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Modify signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Regular removal of debris and vegetation to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is accessible and safe.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic to residential speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees in a new furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Installing curb extensions at potential crossing points would increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Adding a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage would provide a designated and safer space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns at the nearest intersections to provide designated safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Tree Pit Expansion
interventions.description: Enlarge the tree pit or use structural soil to accommodate the mature tree's roots without further damaging the sidewalk pavement.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Add speed cushions to the roadway to reduce vehicle speeds to a level safer for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Clearing
interventions.description: Increase the effective width of the walkway and provide designated areas for trash storage to keep the path clear.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair and level the concrete sidewalk slabs to ensure a smooth, trip-free surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or planters between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Trash Management
interventions.description: Implement policies or provide designated areas for trash bin storage to keep the narrow sidewalk clear of obstructions.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming such as speed humps or raised tables to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Implementing curb extensions at nearby intersections would improve visibility and reduce crossing distances for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Regular removal of debris and trash to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is accessible and safe for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Management
interventions.description: Enforce clear walkway regulations to ensure commercial activity and waste do not obstruct the pedestrian path.
